Pamela’s Natural Refresh ✨

At 60-years-young, Pamela from Oklahoma came to Eden ready for a beautiful, natural transformation. 🌸

Her rejuvenation plan with Dr. Charafeddine combined the EVELift® and Four Point Support — a powerful duo for lifted contours, smoother skin, and restored balance.

Performed under local anesthesia with IV sedation, this Facelift and Necklift approach offers minimal downtime, fast recovery, and natural long lasting results that speak for themselves.

Pamela’s glow-up is just beginning — stay tuned tomorrow for her 24-hour post-op reveal! 👀✨

“You're 70 just for the next 2 hours.” 😎

Donna traveled from Atlanta for her EVELift® — and Dr. C has a plan to bring out her natural beauty. With those sculpted cheekbones and strong features, here’s what’s on the agenda:

✨ EVELift® to contour and redefine
✨ CO2 laser resurfacing
✨ Stem cell therapy to the midface
✨ Volume under the eyes
✨ IPL for chest rejuvenation

And those thick platysmal bands? Handled.

👉 Tune in tomorrow to see what 70 looks like… after Dr. Charafeddine’s magic.

Wondering why the EVELift®?
